categories.main_business_segments: Fujian Yuanli Active Carbon Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the chemical raw materials and chemical products manufacturing industry, focusing on the research, production, and sales of activated carbon, sodium silicate, and silica gel. The company also engages in the development of new energy carbon materials and related clean energy products. Its business segments include wood-based activated carbon, sodium silicate products, silica gel production, and heat energy services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced continuous, clean, and automated production technologies for activated carbon, sodium silicate, and silica gel. It holds numerous patents, including 59 for activated carbon and several for sodium silicate and silica gel, reflecting strong R&D capabilities. Key technologies include large-scale phosphoric acid method for clean activated carbon production, high-pressure electric field technology for gas pollutant removal, and integrated heat energy utilization in production processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Yuanli serves diverse industries such as food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, chemical industry, water treatment, air purification, metallurgy, white carbon black, silicone rubber, and new energy sectors like power batteries and energy storage. Its products are sold domestically across most provinces and exported to Asia, Europe, and other regions. The company maintains long-term cooperative relationships with high-quality downstream enterprises.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates seven major production bases located in Fujian (Nanping, Putian), Jiangxi (Yushan), Inner Mongolia (Manzhouli), Liaoning (Panjin), and Shanghai, covering key domestic forestry and wood processing areas. It serves both domestic and international markets, with approximately 84% of revenue from China and 16% from overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yuanli operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing activated carbon and related chemical products. It integrates upstream raw material procurement (wood residues, biomass) and downstream product applications by developing a circular industrial park that links activated carbon, sodium silicate, silica gel, and clean energy production, enhancing supply chain synergy and resource recycling.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technology innovation as its core strategy, investing heavily in R&D to improve production efficiency, product quality, and environmental sustainability. Key R&D directions include development of high-performance supercapacitor activated carbon, catalytic carrier carbon, carbon capture technologies, and new energy carbon materials like biomass hard carbon and porous carbon. It also focuses on expanding pharmaceutical-grade activated carbon and enhancing its circular economy industrial park.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of chemical products including activated carbon, sodium silicate, and silica gel. The company uses a direct sales model predominantly, supplemented by distributor sales. It also earns income from investment returns and government subsidies related to environmental and technological innovation initiatives.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yuanli is a leading domestic player in the wood-based activated carbon industry, holding the largest production and sales scale in China with over 140,000 tons annual capacity. It competes with both domestic small and medium enterprises and international companies from the US, Japan, and Europe. Its technological and scale advantages position it as a market leader with growing brand influence and expanding export footprint.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.88 billion, a slight decrease of 6.57% year-over-year, but net profit attributable to shareholders increased by 19.95% to RMB 284.45 million. Total assets reached RMB 4.01 billion with a net asset value of RMB 3.31 billion, reflecting steady growth and improved profitability. The company maintains strong cash flow from operations despite increased investment activities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yuanli differentiates itself through advanced, patented production technologies enabling large-scale, clean, and cost-effective manufacturing of high-quality activated carbon and related products. Its comprehensive product portfolio covers diverse raw materials and specifications, meeting varied customer needs. The company’s integrated circular industrial park enhances resource efficiency and sustainability, while its focus on new energy carbon materials and pharmaceutical-grade products positions it for future growth in high-value markets.
